off_by_one.name: Off-by-one error
off_by_one.description: Loop bound or index is +/-1 from the correct value
off_by_one.typical_symptom: Boundary value tests fail; first or last element handled wrong

wrong_operator.name: Wrong operator
wrong_operator.description: Comparison or logical operator swapped (</<=, >/>=, +/-, and/or, in/not in)
wrong_operator.injection_method: Replace the operator with its near-twin
wrong_operator.typical_symptom: Logic takes wrong branch under specific input shape

integer_division.name: Integer division
integer_division.description: // used where / is needed (or vice versa)
integer_division.typical_symptom: Floats truncated or wrong type returned

boundary_condition.name: Boundary condition
boundary_condition.description: Edge case (empty input, single element, zero, negative) not handled
boundary_condition.injection_method: Remove or invert the edge case guard
boundary_condition.typical_symptom: Edge tests fail while normal tests pass

variable_shadowing.name: Variable shadowing
variable_shadowing.description: Inner-scope variable hides outer scope, wrong value referenced
variable_shadowing.injection_method: Reuse a variable name in an inner scope
variable_shadowing.typical_symptom: Specific paths return stale or unrelated values

wrong_index.name: Wrong index
wrong_index.description: arr[i] vs arr[i-1] vs arr[i+1] confusion
wrong_index.injection_method: Shift index by +/-1 or swap to wrong axis
wrong_index.typical_symptom: Output shifted or IndexError on edges

type_coercion.name: Type coercion
type_coercion.injection_method: Remove a cast or compare across mixed types
type_coercion.typical_symptom: TypeError or wrong-type output for some inputs

missing_return.name: Missing return
missing_return.description: Code path returns None instead of the expected value
missing_return.injection_method: Remove a return statement or short-circuit a branch to False
missing_return.typical_symptom: Specific inputs return None or wrong default

wrong_default.name: Wrong default
wrong_default.description: Default parameter or initial accumulator value is wrong
wrong_default.injection_method: Change the initial value (0 vs 1 vs -inf, etc)
wrong_default.typical_symptom: All outputs off by a constant or fail on boundary inputs

accumulator_error.name: Accumulator error
accumulator_error.description: Accumulator updated with the wrong expression
accumulator_error.injection_method: Change what is added or which variable is updated
accumulator_error.typical_symptom: Outputs grow at wrong rate or stay stuck
